purpose: Define what the Sourceborn tool must show and allow the user to edit when an input sentence/question is decomposed and interpreted.
entry_rule: Every user ask may open a reviewable micro-Sequence view. The normal answer may remain concise, but the structured reasoning objects must be inspectable without exposing hidden chain-of-thought; the UI shows explicit machine records, evidence, rubric activations, typed inferences and trace objects only.

panels.name: SMALL_BRAIN_AND_ENGINE_TRACE
panels.guard: Show explicit trace records and bounded local result summaries; do not expose private hidden chain-of-thought.

edit_semantics.wrong_split: Creates decomposition correction; raw sentence remains unchanged.
edit_semantics.wrong_parameter: Creates activation correction and review trace; native parameter definition remains unchanged.
edit_semantics.emotion_change: Stores user-attributed emotional meaning for the configured scope; does not assert universal Human truth.
edit_semantics.intent_change: Stores explicit user attribution unless supported by direct evidence; does not silently become observed intent.
edit_semantics.rubric_change: Creates RUBRIC_CHANGE_CANDIDATE and enters formal adoption workflow.

performance_rule: Correctness and traceability precede speed during Phase-2. The runtime may progressively reveal/defer deeper levels, but must not skip required Sequence, provenance, barrier, review or closure laws merely to answer faster.
